editorial_explanation: Minimal free covers are the inductive construction step of minimal free resolutions.
Vanishing differentials after tensoring with the residue field identifies Tor with graded free ranks.
Maps with entries in the maximal ideal induce zero maps on Ext from the residue field.
Connecting morphisms for complexes explain long exact Tor sequences; Ext uses the cohomological counterpart.
Schanuel gives stable syzygy equivalence, not uniqueness of arbitrary free resolutions.
Both involve polynomial syzygies/resolutions, but for different modules; no direct derivation.
Periodic nonvanishing Tor forces infinite projective dimension; CP-V-0043 assumes finite projective dimension.
The projective dimension detected by minimal resolutions is the term used in Auslander--Buchsbaum.
Quotient-ideal Tor calculation specializes to cyclic quotients of Z.
A concrete Ext^1 calculation illustrates derived functors; it does not by itself establish the general long exact sequence.
